description: Read one Slovak methodological guidance document with its text in slices. Give one key form: the id (uuid from sk-metodika_search or sk-metodika_lookup), or fonte + source_id, or tipo + numero + anno (numero as printed, for example 10/DZPaU/2026/MP, written with its slashes and not encoded; the estremi can match several rows, and documents without numero, such as NBS stanoviska, are reachable by id or fonte + source_id only). Returns id, fonte, source_id, legacy_doc_id, ente, tipo, section, group_label, numero, anno, data, oggetto, the text slice (offset 0-based, length 1..50000 characters, default 20000), text_length, truncated, next_offset (the offset of the next slice, null at the end), text_source (pdf = text layer, ocr = local OCR of a scan), source_url (the PDF on the authority's site: the binding text) and pdf_bytes, pdf_pages. No row means the document is not in the corpus. Guidance is not a source of law; the corpus text is a derived extract, the PDF is the original. Example: {"id": "3f2c...", "offset": 20000}.
